SELECT  e.id
        , e.code
        , e.review_type
        , e.review_object
        , e.review_first_datetime AS reviewfirsttime
        , e.review_latest_datetime AS reviewnewtime
        , e.risk_event
        , e.risk_detail
        , e.risk_grade
        , e.risk_status
        , If( e.deal_type IS NULL
            OR e.deal_type = '', '--', e.deal_type ) AS dealtype
        , e.deal_result
        , If( e.deal_remark IS NULL
            OR e.deal_remark = '', '--', e.deal_remark ) AS dealremark
        , e.is_deleted
        , e.review_object_id
        , e.archive_id
        , e.feature AS featurename
        , Ifnull( ( SELECT real_name
                    FROM bladex.blade_user
                    WHERE id = e.review_first_user ), ( SELECT DISTINCT
                                                            real_name
                                                        FROM app_sys.asys_uniapp_rn_auth
                                                        WHERE uniapp_user_id = e.review_first_user
                                                            AND is_disable = 0 ) ) AS reviewfirstuser
        , Ifnull( ( SELECT real_name
                    FROM bladex.blade_user
                    WHERE id = e.review_latest_user ), (    SELECT DISTINCT
                                                                real_name
                                                            FROM app_sys.asys_uniapp_rn_auth
                                                            WHERE uniapp_user_id = e.review_latest_user
                                                                AND is_disable = 0 ) ) AS reviewnewuser
        , If( ( SELECT real_name
                FROM bladex.blade_user
                WHERE id = e.deal_user ) IS NOT NULL
            AND e.deal_user != - 9999, (    SELECT real_name
                                            FROM bladex.blade_user
                                            WHERE id = e.deal_user ), '--' ) AS dealuser
        , CASE
                WHEN 'COMPANY'
                    THEN Concat( (  SELECT ar.customer_name
                                    FROM mtp_cs.mtp_rsk_cust_archive ar
                                    WHERE ar.is_deleted = 0
                                        AND ar.id = e.archive_id ), If( (   SELECT alias
                                                                            FROM web_crm.wcrm_customer
                                                                            WHERE id = e.customer_id ) = ''
                OR (    SELECT alias
                        FROM web_crm.wcrm_customer
                        WHERE id = e.customer_id ) IS NULL, ' ', Concat( '（', ( SELECT alias
                                                                                FROM web_crm.wcrm_customer
                                                                                WHERE id = e.customer_id ), '）' ) ) )
                WHEN 'EMPLOYEE'
                    THEN (  SELECT Concat( auth.real_name, ' ', auth.phone )
                            FROM app_sys.asys_uniapp_rn_auth auth
                            WHERE auth.is_disable = 0
                                AND auth.uniapp_user_id = e.uniapp_user_id )
                WHEN 'DEAL'
                    THEN (  SELECT DISTINCT
                                Concat( batch.code, '-', detail.line_seq
                                        , ' ', Ifnull( (    SELECT DISTINCT
                                                                auth.real_name
                                                            FROM app_sys.asys_uniapp_rn_auth auth
                                                            WHERE auth.uniapp_user_id = e.uniapp_user_id
                                                                AND auth.is_disable = 0 ), ' ' ) )
                            FROM web_pym.wpym_payment_batch_detail detail
                                LEFT JOIN web_pym.wpym_payment_batch batch
                                    ON detail.payment_batch_id = batch.id
                            WHERE detail.id = e.review_object_id )
                WHEN 'TASK'
                    THEN (  SELECT code
                            FROM web_tm.wtm_task task
                            WHERE e.review_object_id = task.id )
                ELSE NULL
            END AS reviewobjectname
        , CASE
                WHEN 4
                    THEN 'HIGH_LEVEL'
                WHEN 3
                    THEN 'MEDIUM_LEVEL'
                WHEN 2
                    THEN 'LOW_LEVEL'
                ELSE 'HEALTHY'
            END AS risklevel
FROM mtp_cs.mtp_rsk_event e
WHERE e.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY e.review_latest_datetime DESC
LIMIT 30
;

    select 1 as item_id, 1 as basket_id
    |> UNION ALL
      (select 2, 1),
      (select 3, 1),
      (select 4, 2)
  ), item as (
    select 1 as item_id, 'milk' as name
    |> UNION ALL
      (select 2, "chocolate"),

    FROM client c
    |> aggregate count(i.item_id) as bought_item
       group by c.client_id, i.item_id, i.name

       group by client_id
  )
  select * from wrapper
)

SELECT DDF.tablespace                                  TABLESPACE_NAME
         , maxtotal / 1024 / 1024                        "MAX_MB"
         , ( total - free ) / 1024 / 1024                "USED_MB"
         , ( maxtotal - ( total - free ) ) / 1024 / 1024 "AVAILABLE_MB"
         , total / 1024 / 1024                           "ALLOCATED_MB"
         , free / 1024 / 1024                            "ALLOCATED_FREE_MB"
         , ( ( total - free ) / maxtotal * 100 )         "USED_PERC"
         , cnt                                           "FILE_COUNT"
  FROM   (SELECT tablespace_name                  TABLESPACE
                 , SUM(bytes)                     TOTAL
                 , SUM(Greatest(maxbytes, bytes)) MAXTOTAL
                 , Count(*)                       CNT
          FROM   dba_data_files
          GROUP  BY tablespace_name) DDF
         , (SELECT tablespace_name TABLESPACE
                   , SUM(bytes)    FREE
                   , Max(bytes)    MAXF
            FROM   dba_free_space
            GROUP  BY tablespace_name) DFS
  WHERE  DDF.tablespace = DFS.tablespace
  ORDER  BY 1 DESC

SELECT sum(iif(diff = 7, lc_lv, 0)) AS lc_7
FROM (  SELECT  a.day
                , a.channel_type
                , a.username
                , a.diff
                , a.cnt
                , lc
                ,  Cast( lc / cnt AS DECIMAL (38, 4) ) AS lc_lv
        FROM (  SELECT  a.day
                        , a.channel_type
                        , a.username
                        , Datediff( b.day, a.day )
                             + 1 AS diff
                        , cnt
                        , Count( DISTINCT b.user_id ) AS lc
                FROM (  SELECT  a.day
                                , a.user_id
                                , channel_id channel_type
                                , adtrace_adgroup_id AS username
                        FROM (  SELECT  day
                                        , a.user_id
                                        , last_login_channel_id AS channel_id
                                        , last_adtrace_adgroup_id AS adtrace_adgroup_id
                                FROM (  SELECT  day
                                                , user_id
                                                , yidevice
                                        FROM (  SELECT  day
                                                        , user_id
                                                        , yidevice
                                                        , Row_Number(  )
                                                                OVER (PARTITION BY day, user_id ORDER BY event_time) AS rk
                                                FROM dwd_table.event_pj
                                                WHERE day BETWEEN '2025-05-30'
                                                                 AND '2025-06-06'
                                                    AND event_id = 'device_login'
                                                    AND yidevice IS NOT NULL
                                                    AND yidevice != '' ) a
                                        WHERE rk = 1 ) a
                                    LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT
                                                    From_Unixtime(  Cast( (  Cast( last_adtrace_time AS BIGINT ) + 28800000 ) / 1000 AS BIGINT ), 'yyyy-MM-dd' ) AS last_adtrace_dt
                                                    , yidevice
                                                    , last_login_channel_id
                                                    , last_adtrace_adgroup_id
                                                    , last_adtrace_creative_id
                                                FROM dwd_user.yidevice_pj
                                                WHERE  Cast( adtrace_reattributed_times AS INT ) > 0
                                                    AND Datediff( From_Unixtime(  Cast( (  Cast( last_adtrace_time AS BIGINT ) + 28800000 ) / 1000 AS BIGINT ), 'yyyy-MM-dd' ), create_date ) >= 30
                                                    AND From_Unixtime(  Cast( (  Cast( last_adtrace_time AS BIGINT ) + 28800000 ) / 1000 AS BIGINT ), 'yyyy-MM-dd' ) BETWEEN '2025-05-30'
                                                                                                                                                                         AND '2025-06-06' ) b
                                        ON a.day = b.last_adtrace_dt
                                            AND a.yidevice = b.yidevice ) a  ) a
                    LEFT JOIN ( SELECT  day
                                        , user_id
                                FROM dwd_table.event_pj
                                WHERE day BETWEEN '2025-05-30'
                                                 AND '2025-06-06'
                                    AND event_id = 'login'
                                GROUP BY    day
                                            , user_id ) b
                        ON a.user_id = b.user_id
                    LEFT JOIN ( SELECT  a.day
                                        , channel_type
                                        , username
                                        , Count( DISTINCT a.user_id ) AS cnt
                                FROM (  SELECT  a.day
                                                , a.user_id
                                                , channel_id AS channel_type
                                                , adtrace_adgroup_id username
                                        FROM (  SELECT  day
                                                        , a.user_id
                                                        , last_login_channel_id AS channel_id
                                                        , last_adtrace_adgroup_id AS adtrace_adgroup_id
                                                FROM (  SELECT  day
                                                                , user_id
                                                                , yidevice
                                                        FROM (  SELECT  day
                                                                        , user_id
                                                                        , yidevice
                                                                        , Row_Number(  )
                                                                                OVER (PARTITION BY day, user_id ORDER BY event_time) AS rk
                                                                FROM dwd_table.event_pj
                                                                WHERE day BETWEEN '2025-05-30'
                                                                                 AND '2025-06-06'
                                                                    AND event_id = 'device_login'
                                                                    AND yidevice IS NOT NULL
                                                                    AND yidevice != '' ) a
                                                        WHERE rk = 1 ) a
                                                    LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT
                                                                    From_Unixtime(  Cast( (  Cast( last_adtrace_time AS BIGINT ) + 28800000 ) / 1000 AS BIGINT ), 'yyyy-MM-dd' ) AS last_adtrace_dt
                                                                    , yidevice
                                                                    , last_login_channel_id
                                                                    , last_adtrace_adgroup_id
                                                                    , last_adtrace_creative_id
                                                                FROM dwd_user.yidevice_pj
                                                                WHERE  Cast( adtrace_reattributed_times AS INT ) > 0
                                                                    AND Datediff( From_Unixtime(  Cast( (  Cast( last_adtrace_time AS BIGINT ) + 28800000 ) / 1000 AS BIGINT ), 'yyyy-MM-dd' ), create_date ) >= 30
                                                                    AND From_Unixtime(  Cast( (  Cast( last_adtrace_time AS BIGINT ) + 28800000 ) / 1000 AS BIGINT ), 'yyyy-MM-dd' ) BETWEEN '2025-05-30'
                                                                                                                                                                                         AND '2025-06-06' ) b
                                                        ON a.day = b.last_adtrace_dt
                                                            AND a.yidevice = b.yidevice ) a  ) a
                                GROUP BY    a.day
                                            , channel_type
                                            , username ) c
                        ON a.day = c.day
                            AND a.channel_type = c.channel_type
                            AND a.username = c.username
                GROUP BY    a.day
                            , a.channel_type
                            , a.username
                            , diff
                            , cnt ) a
        WHERE diff > 1
            AND diff <= 7 ) a
GROUP BY    username
            , channel_type
            , day
            , cnt
ORDER BY    username DESC
            , channel_type
            , day DESC
;

MERGE INTO DestinationValue Dest USING
(SELECT TheMonth ,
  IdentifyingKey ,
  SUM(NetPrice) NetPrice ,
  SUM(NetDeductionPrice) NetDeductionPrice ,
  MAX(CASE RowNumberMain WHEN 1 THEN QualityIndicator ELSE NULL END) QualityIndicatorMain ,
  MAX(CASE RowNumberDeduction WHEN 1 THEN QualityIndicator ELSE NULL END) QualityIndicatorDeduction 
FROM
  (SELECT pd.TheMonth ,
    COALESCE(pd.IdentifyingKey, 0) IdentifyingKey ,
    COALESCE(CASE pd.IsDeduction WHEN 1 THEN NULL ELSE ConvertedCalculatedValue END, 0) NetPrice ,
    COALESCE(CASE pd.IsDeduction WHEN 1 THEN ConvertedCalculatedValue ELSE NULL END, 0) NetDeductionPrice ,
    pd.QualityIndicator ,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pd.TheMonth , pd.IdentifyingKey ORDER BY COALESCE(pd.QualityMonth, to_date('18991230', 'yyyymmdd')) DESC ) RowNumberMain ,
    NULL RowNumberDeduction
  FROM PricingData pd
  WHERE pd.ThingsKey      IN (:ThingsKeys)
  AND pd.TheMonth       >= :startdate
  AND pd.TheMonth       <= :enddate
  AND pd.IsDeduction = 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT pd.TheMonth ,
    COALESCE(pd.IdentifyingKey, 0) IdentifyingKey ,
    COALESCE(CASE pd.IsDeduction WHEN 1 THEN NULL ELSE ConvertedCalculatedValue END, 0) NetPrice ,
    COALESCE(CASE pd.IsDeduction WHEN 1 THEN ConvertedCalculatedValue ELSE NULL END, 0) NetDeductionPrice ,
    pd.QualityIndicator ,
    NULL RowNumberMain ,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pd.TheMonth , pd.IdentifyingKey ORDER BY COALESCE(pd.QualityMonth, to_date('18991230', 'yyyymmdd')) DESC ) RowNumberDeduction 
  FROM PricingData pd
  WHERE pd.ThingsKey       IN (:ThingsKeys)
  AND pd.TheMonth        >= :startdate
  AND pd.TheMonth        <= :enddate
  AND pd.IsDeduction <> 0
  )
GROUP BY TheMonth ,
  IdentifyingKey
) Data ON ( Dest.TheMonth = Data.TheMonth 
            AND COALESCE(Dest.IdentifyingKey,0) = Data.IdentifyingKey )
WHEN MATCHED THEN
  UPDATE
  SET NetPrice        = ROUND(Data.NetPrice, PriceDecimalScale) ,
    DeductionPrice    = ROUND(Data.NetDeductionPrice, PriceDecimalScale) ,
    SubTotalPrice     = ROUND(Data.NetPrice + (Data.NetDeductionPrice * Dest.HasDeductions), PriceDecimalScale) ,
    QualityIndicator  =
    CASE Dest.HasDeductions
      WHEN 0
      THEN Data.QualityIndicatorMain
      ELSE
        CASE
          WHEN COALESCE(Data.CheckMonth1, to_date('18991230', 'yyyymmdd'))> COALESCE(Data.CheckMonth2,to_date('18991230', 'yyyymmdd'))
          THEN Data.QualityIndicatorMain
          ELSE Data.QualityIndicatorDeduction
        END
    END ,
    RecUser = :recuser ,
    RecDate = :recdate
  WHERE 1 =1
  AND IsImportant = 1
  AND COALESCE(Data.SomeFlag,-1) <> COALESCE(ROUND(Something, 1),-1)
  DELETE WHERE
  IsImportant = 0
  OR COALESCE(Data.SomeFlag,-1) = COALESCE(ROUND(Something, 1),-1)
 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN 
  INSERT
    (
      TheMonth ,
      ThingsKey ,
      IsDeduction ,
      CreatedAt 
    )
    VALUES
    (
      Data.TheMonth ,
      Data.ThingsKey ,
      Data.IsDeduction ,
      SYSDATE
    )

SELECT table_a.b_e_t,
       CASE
           WHEN table_a.g_o_a_c IS NULL THEN 'a'
           ELSE table_a.g_o_a_c
           END                                        AS e_cd,
       CASE
           WHEN table_a.a_f_t IS NULL THEN 'b'
           ELSE table_a.a_f_t
           END                                        AS a_f_t,
       COUNT(1)                                       AS count,
       ROUND(ABS(SUM(table_a.gb_eq))::NUMERIC, 2) AS total_x
FROM (SELECT table_x.b_e_t,
             table_x.b_e_a,
             table_y.g_o_a_c,
             table_z.a_f_t,
             CASE
                 WHEN table_x.b_e_a IS NOT NULL THEN table_x.b_e_a::DOUBLE PRECISION /
                                                                 schema_z.g_c_r(table_x.c_c,
                                                                                  'x'::CHARACTER VARYING,
                                                                                  table_x.r_ts::DATE)
                 ELSE
                     CASE
                         WHEN table_x.b_e_t::TEXT = 'p_e'::TEXT THEN (SELECT ((
                                 (table_x.pld::JSON -> 'p_d'::TEXT) ->>
                                 's_a'::TEXT)::DOUBLE PRECISION) / schema_z.g_c_r(fba.s_c_c,
                                                                                             'x'::CHARACTER VARYING,
                                                                                             table_x.r_ts::DATE)
                                                                                                   FROM schema_z.f_b_a fba
                                                                                                            JOIN schema_z.t_b_a_n_i table_y
                                                                                                                 ON fba.b_a_i = table_y.f_b_a_id
                                                                                                   WHERE table_y.t_ngn_id =
                                                                                                         (((table_x.pld::JSON -> 'p_d'::TEXT) ->>
                                                                                                           's_a_i'::TEXT)::BIGINT))
                         WHEN table_x.b_e_t::TEXT = 'i_e'::TEXT
                             THEN (SELECT (((table_x.pld::JSON -> 'i_d'::TEXT) ->> 'a'::TEXT)::DOUBLE PRECISION) /
                                          schema_z.g_c_r(fba.s_c_c, 'x'::CHARACTER VARYING,
                                                           table_x.r_ts::DATE)
                                   FROM schema_z.f_b_a fba
                                            JOIN schema_z.t_b_a_n_i table_y
                                                 ON fba.b_a_i = table_y.f_b_a_id
                                   WHERE table_y.t_ngn_id = (((table_x.pld::JSON -> 'i_d'::TEXT) ->>
                                                             's_a_i'::TEXT)::BIGINT))
                         WHEN table_x.b_e_t::TEXT = 'i_e_2'::TEXT
                             THEN (SELECT (((table_x.pld::JSON -> 'i_d'::TEXT) ->> 'a'::TEXT)::DOUBLE PRECISION) /
                                          schema_z.g_c_r(fba.s_c_c, 'x'::CHARACTER VARYING,
                                                           table_x.r_ts::DATE)
                                   FROM schema_z.f_b_a fba
                                            JOIN schema_z.t_b_a_n_i table_y
                                                 ON fba.b_a_i = table_y.f_b_a_id
                                   WHERE table_y.t_ngn_id = (((table_x.pld::JSON -> 'id'::TEXT) ->>
                                                             'd_i'::TEXT)::BIGINT))
                         WHEN table_x.b_e_t::TEXT = 'm_e'::TEXT
                             THEN (SELECT (((table_x.pld::JSON -> 'o'::TEXT) ->> 'eda'::TEXT)::DOUBLE PRECISION) /
                                          schema_z.g_c_r(
                                                  ((table_x.pld::JSON -> 'o'::TEXT) ->> 'dc'::TEXT)::CHARACTER VARYING,
                                                  'x'::CHARACTER VARYING, table_x.r_ts::DATE))
                         ELSE NULL::DOUBLE PRECISION
                         END
                 END AS gb_eq
      FROM schema_z.baz
               LEFT JOIN f_ctl.g_o_f_e_t_a_m table_y
                         ON table_x.p_e_m LIKE table_y.f_e_m_p
               LEFT JOIN f_ctl.g_o_c_a_t table_z
                         ON table_z.c_a_t_c = table_y.g_o_a_c
      WHERE table_x.p_st = 'E'
     ) table_a
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
